project.title: Momoland
project.logline:
Write a sharp, high-chemistry GL scene (around 1,000 words) featuring academic/art rivals with intense bantering.
Characters:

Character A: Proud, competitive, composed, but secretly fascinated by Character B’s talent.

Character B: Bold, expressive, provocative, loves challenging Character A and seeing her lose composure.
Plot: Locked inside the university art studio/library after hours while preparing for an exhibition. An argument over their contrasting styles escalates into an intimate confrontation. Standing inches apart amidst paint stains and scattered canvases, their fierce rivalry blurs into an overwhelming, breathless romantic tension.
